**Same problem, two halves:** Variantyx pushes DNA yield higher (short + long reads, repeats, methylation); PhiTech says DNA-only tests diagnose **fewer than 40%** of rare-disease cases and adds RNA evidence (splicing, expression, allele-specific expression) on top.
**Multi-omics direction:** Genomic Unity 2.0 already reports methylation — an epigenomic layer. Saliha's G&M pipelines add transcriptomics and epigenomics to genomics.
No shared employer, school, city or co-authorship found between Angela and Saliha or Tunahan — her career is not on the open web.

lead_with.title: Unsolved cases after WGS
lead_with.text: Ask how many Genomic Unity cases come back negative or with a VUS. G&M's **RNA-Seq analysis against structured control cohorts** (aberrant splicing, abnormal expression, allele-specific expression) is built to resolve exactly those — PhiTech claims **up to 30% more diagnostic yield**.

lead_with.title: Add RNA without building it
lead_with.text: Variantyx publicly sells DNA tests only. G&M lets the lab offer a **reflex RNA step** — the same model Variantyx already uses to reflex from Genomic Unity to 2.0 — without developing an RNA pipeline in-house.

lead_with.title: Pilot on her own data
lead_with.text: Propose a retrospective pilot: a small set of WGS-negative cases with RNA, analysed by G&M, results reviewed with Angela's team. Low risk, measurable yield.

company.text: Variantyx (Framingham, MA) is a CLIA- and CAP-compliant molecular diagnostics lab focused on rare genetic disease. Its **Genomic Unity®** whole-genome test detects multiple variant types from one sample in one report; **Genomic Unity 2.0** (Sep 2024) adds Oxford Nanopore long reads, 44+ repeat expansions, methylation status and phasing (institutional price US$4,400 proband, US$6,400 trio; 10–12 week turnaround). It also runs **IriSight** prenatal CNV analysis and has expanded into oncology. Health systems using its technology include Penn Medicine, Mayo Clinic, Cleveland Clinic, Emory, Mount Sinai and Johns Hopkins. Leadership named in press: Haim Neerman (co-founder, CEO), Christine Stanley, PhD, FACMG (Chief Genomics & Compliance Officer; NY State lists her as lab director), Lucy Kaplun (Director of Advanced Development).

financials.text: **Total raised:** over US$125M (Apr 2024). **Rounds:** US$20M (Mar 2021); **US$41.5M Series C** led by New Era Capital Partners; US$20M from Kreos Capital (Oct 2022); **US$36M** from Peregrine Ventures, Pitango HealthTech, New Era and Bosch Ventures (Apr 2024), citing rapid test-volume growth. No revenue published.
